hooks.name: software
hooks.reason: Refuses every spec field and marks the kind as the Servers' directory client, whose install receives the installation's Directory settings from the core; the catalog entry travels with it.

sssd_unsupported_os.remediation: The directory client is supported on Ubuntu only; Servers with another OS keep local accounts and the provisioner's keys.

sssd_settings_missing.remediation: The install did not receive the Directory settings; check that the installation has a Directory configured and install again.

sssd_id_conflict.remediation: A local account or group on the Server uses an id in swallow's POSIX range; remove or renumber it, then install again.

sssd_name_conflict.remediation: A local account or group on the Server has the name of a swallow User or group; remove or rename it, then install again.

sssd_sshd_config_invalid.remediation: sshd refused its configuration with swallow's drop-in; the drop-in was removed, so fix the Server's sshd configuration and install again.

sssd_directory_unreachable.remediation: The Server could not read the Directory: check that it reaches the installation address on port 636 and that its clock is synchronized, then retry.
